questions.question: What is 'the branch of the LORD' called in Isaiah 4?
What will the LORD create over Mount Zion as protection?
options: A wide river flowing through the midst of the holy mountain
A very high wall of cut stone built all around the city
A cloud by day and a flaming fire by night, a canopy
A great and mighty army encamped on every single side
questions.answer: A cloud by day and a flaming fire by night, a canopy
